text: $QNT surged 26.2% and ripped through an 82.1% 24-hour range, that's more than three times its usual swing. $HBAR jumped 36.9% and covered a 27.6% range, roughly 3.5 × its normal volatility. $UNI slipped 7.8% but only widened to a 13.2% range, barely above its typical 10.6%, basically a regular day. All three moved hard, but $QNT and $HBAR were the real outliers. Nothing else crazy on the board.
